newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan oil demand in May climbs 1.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan oil demand in May climbs 1.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japanese oil demand rose by 1.7 percent in May from the same month a year earlier to 19.87 million kilolitres (kl), or 4.03 million barrels per day (bpd), Trade Ministry statistics showed on Tuesday.
The figure groups domestic sales of petroleum products with crude oil purchased for direct burning in electricity generation, petrochemical and fertiliser production and other uses.
Domestic product sales climbed 2.4 percent to 18.67 million kl (3.79 million bpd), of which sales of fuel oil C amounted to 2.9 million kl, up 1.6 percent from May 1996.
It was the first year-on-year increase in fuel oil C sales in six months, due to hefty demand from power utilities.

A Ministry of International Trade and Industry official said this was partly because power utilities stepped up thermal power plant operations to make up for a slight decline in nuclear plant operations.
Jet fuel and kerosene sales declined year-on-year, but naphtha sales jumped 9.5 percent in May to 3.9 million kl, lifted by brisk purchases by the petrochemical industry.
Oil product stocks rose 14 percent from a year earlier to 14.4 million kl at the end of May.
Kerosene showed a particularly large year-on-year stock increase, climbing 47.1 percent from May 1996 to 3.1 million kl this May.
The Trade Ministry official said figures for kerosene stocks were higher year-on-year, partly because kerosene inventories last year were kept low.
The high product inventory has been a factor that prompted at least one Japanese oil company to decide to reduce throughput levels recently.
Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Monday that it had trimmed runs by about one to two percent because of large oil product stocks.
Crude oil purchased for direct burning by electric utilities in April fell by 6.7 percent from year-earlier levels to 895,670 kl (182,000 bpd), the ministry's statistics showed.
Crude oil for petrochemical use in May was 11.2 percent lower than the same month a year earlier, at 304,543 kl (62,000 bpd)
